name: @hyperd-ai/plugin-hyperd
description: ElizaOS plugin for hyperD — on-demand DeFi intelligence (wallet risk, token security, liquidation alerts, P&L, DEX quotes, synthesis-tier composed verdicts) paid per-call in USDC on Base via the x402 protocol. No API key, no signup.
author: Thomas Potter <hi@hyperd.ai>

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build

HYPERD_API_BASE.description: Base URL for the hyperD API. Defaults to production.

HYPERD_BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY.description: EVM private key (0x-prefixed, 32-byte hex) holding USDC on Base for x402 micropayments. The plugin signs EIP-3009 transfer authorizations with this key. Base-tier costs are $0.02–$0.10/call; synthesis-tier costs are $0.30–$1.50/call.

HYPERD_MAX_USDC_PER_CALL.description: Hard cap on USDC payment authorized per call. Refuses calls priced above this. Default $0.25 covers all base-tier actions. Raise to $2.00 to enable synthesis-tier actions (up to $1.50/call).
